workspaceEdits.description: To get past the SAFE allotment tripwire (DOLA_ALLOTMENT/USDC_ALLOTMENT hardcoded 0 + require(>0)), set both to nonzero values within the live owner's balance. Owner held only 0.65 DOLA and 99 USDC on the fork, so the script's suggested 1000e18/1000e6 would fail _preflight. Used small in-balance values instead of deal().
workspaceEdits.edit1: DOLA_ALLOTMENT 0 -> 5e17 (0.5 DOLA), USDC_ALLOTMENT 0 -> 50e6 (50 USDC). Required to reach run() body.
workspaceEdits.edit2_probe_only: Temporarily replaced `IYS(oldYS).setAsideBufferRecipient()` in _carryBuffer with `recipient = STAKER` to bypass the first revert and confirm the SECOND independent revert in _registerOnV2. This was a diagnostic probe only.
workspaceEdits.revertCommand: git checkout script/MigrateSaga2Deploy.s.sol — workspace restored to pristine 6d733ab (allotments back to 0).

executed.revertReason: EvmError: Revert (empty revert data) — staticcall to old strategy `setAsideBufferRecipient()` (selector 0x88b57777) at 0x90ce274b20A2aF4265152B369d09ce6E6Dc177F9 reverts because the DEPLOYED old-strategy bytecode predates that getter. Forge surfaces it as `script failed: <empty revert data>`. This is the FIRST of two independent fork reverts.
executed.secondRevertReason: After bypassing the buffer-recipient call, the script reverts AGAIN in `_registerOnV2(USDE,...)` at `MINTER_V1.stablecoinConfigs(USDE)`: the deployed V1 returns a 4-WORD struct (yieldStrategy, exchangeRate=1e18, decimals=18, enabled=1 — raw 128 bytes), but the script's `IMinterV1` interface declares a 7-VALUE return tuple, so the ABI decoder buffer-overruns (224 bytes expected) and the call reverts with empty data.
executed.verdict: AS-SHIPPED-WITH-ALLOTMENTS-SET THE SCRIPT IS UNPREVIEWABLE / UNRUNNABLE AGAINST LIVE MAINNET STATE. Two distinct deployed-ABI-drift reverts, each fatal.

wiringVerification.vaultAssetPairing: PASS — autoDOLA.asset()==DOLA, autoUSDC.asset()==USDC; ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2 ctor args correct; owner==OWNER on both (OwnershipTransferred to 0xCad1...D0B6).
wiringVerification.v2ConfigReplicationFidelity: BLOCKED/FAIL — replication cannot execute on live state: V1 stablecoinConfigs ABI is a 4-field struct, script reads it as 7-field and reverts. Underlying values that WOULD be replicated (DOLA rate=1e18, dec=18) are readable via the correct 4-tuple ABI, so the intent is sound but the interface is drifted.
wiringVerification.phusdMintAuthorityGap: By design (see freeze-gap finding): V1 revoked in 2.1, V2 granted in 2.1, but V2 has NO registered DOLA/USDC stablecoinConfig that succeeds (registration reverts) and is not seeded until 2.2. In the 2.1->2.2 operational window, V1 cannot mint and V2 cannot usefully mint DOLA/USDC -> phUSD mint availability is interrupted for the gap. USDe registration also reverts. Acceptable ONLY if 2.1->2.2 are back-to-back (docs §4 say single session).
wiringVerification.setMigrator: NOT REACHED — step 9 is after the reverting _registerOnV2 calls; setMigrator(migrator) never executes against live state. 2.2's preflight requires staker.migrator()==migrator, so until 2.1 is fixed and run, 2.2 cannot proceed.
wiringVerification.usdeCarry: setClient(minterV2,true) on USDE_MARKET_YS SUCCEEDS (with bypass); V1 left authorized. But the paired _registerOnV2(USDE) reverts, so the USDe carry is left half-done in the bypass run.
wiringVerification.bufferDrift: CONFIRMED — live old-strategy setAsideBufferSize(staker)==25; script hardcodes 10 and logs (but does not assert) the cross-check. 2.3 asserts ==10, so the new value is internally consistent with the downstream gate but represents a 25->10 reduction of the carried buffer.
